CT SCAN - THORAX AND ABDOMEN (PLAIN + CONTRAST)
Patient Name: Mrs. SUNITA DESHMUKH Patient ID: MDC-26-04417
Age / Sex: 51 Years / Female Date of Scan: 20/02/2026
Referred by: Dr. Meena Pawar (MBBS, DGO) Report Date: 20/02/2026
Technique
Axial CT sections of the thorax and abdomen were obtained before and after intravenous administration
of 80 mL non-ionic contrast.
Findings
• Breast: ill-defined enhancing soft tissue lesion in the upper outer quadrant of the left breast,
measuring about 2.4 x 2.1 cm. No skin thickening or nipple retraction.
• Axilla: a few sub-centimetric left axillary lymph nodes, largest 8 mm in short axis.
• Lungs: clear. No nodule, consolidation or pleural effusion.
• Mediastinum: no enlarged lymph nodes. Heart and great vessels are normal.
• Liver, spleen, pancreas, kidneys, adrenals: normal. No focal lesion.
• Bones: no lytic or sclerotic lesion in the visualised skeleton.
Impression
1. Enhancing lesion in the upper outer quadrant of the left breast as described.
Histopathological correlation is advised.
2. No evidence of distant metastasis in the scanned regions.
Imaging findings should be correlated with clinical and laboratory data.
Dr. Kavita Rane
M.D., D.N.B. (Radiodiagnosis)
